headline: Expectancy flips sign on a 2-point change in stop odds, and my record says I under-call stops
reasoning: Setup: long at 82.50 (the last after-hours print, 82.30, plus a dime), stop 77.00 (-6.7%, below the 79.04 first after-hours print; a fall there means the market gave back a third of the gap), target 91.00 (+10.3%, about where a full re-rate on the new EBITDA guide lands). Risk 5.50, reward 8.50. The entry guard arms at 79.75 (82.50 - 0.5 x 5.50). The packet's quote and gap stats failed to load tonight. From my own pull: 60-session mean absolute daily move 2.27%, max 12.97%, max open gap 2.89%.

Fill-conditional odds: we fill if CDNA opens at or below 82.50, or comes back to it, so the strongest openings (+16% and up) are excluded. In the fill worlds: stop first 0.40, target first 0.32, time exit 0.28 at +1.50.
Calibration: across 3 cases I predicted 39% stop-outs and 67% happened. Even a half correction moves p_strike to 0.45-0.47.

At p_strike 0.45 (target 0.29, time exit 0.26): 0.29 x 8.50 + 0.26 x 1.50 - 0.45 x 5.50 = +0.38 a share. At 0.47 (0.28 / 0.25): 2.38 + 0.375 - 2.585 = +0.17 a share. Costs for 25 shares: spread about 0.15% = $3.10, plus slippage $2.50, together $5.60 = 0.22 a share. Net: +0.16 to -0.05 a share, about +$4 to -$1 on $2,060.
Bad-exit cost: a gap through the stop back to 73 (near the pre-report close) at 25 shares is 25 x 9.50 = $238, 4.8% of $4,905 equity.

A trade whose expectancy is +$4 to -$1 against a $238 bad-exit tail is not positive in any way I can defend. That is not a judgment on CareDx's quarter, which is strong. It is the entry: after a +15% after-hours gap, the order fills mainly when the market hesitates. horizon_days 5 would be kept.
objections: 1. After-hours price on odd lots only (SCOUT).
2. Possible one-time catch-up in the EPS beat (ANALYST, SKEPTIC).
3. +15% after hours prices much of the re-rate (SKEPTIC).
5. The crew's comparable longs did not work (SKEPTIC).
6. Calibration: stops happen more often than I predict (39% predicted, 67% actual).
7. Net expectancy about +$4 to -$1: not positive once costs and calibration are counted.
